reserveReview.rationale: At rise block 23375290, symbol/decimals and EIP-1967 implementation/admin were re-read. Local backing balance was 4,186,507.178834 M against 4,166,902.771484 USDR supply. M-extension wrapping and unwrapping conserve the deposited M claim. The current SwapFacility restricts direct M output to approved swappers; an unprivileged sample canSwapViaPath(child,wM) returned true while child-to-M returned false. This is technical conversion eligibility, not a sent transaction or a cash redemption right. USDR JMI totalAssets() returned zero, so no non-M asset slice is assigned.
